newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-July rolled steel imports up 24.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-July rolled steel imports up 24.2 pct.

text.p: China's imports of rolled steel were 9.14 million tonnes in the first seven months of this year, up 24.2 percent over the same period last year, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
Imports of steel plate during the January-July period were up 63.5 percent year-on-year to 6.02 million tonnes, Xinhua quoted official statistics as showing.
Foreign-funded firms imported 1.73 million tonnes of rolled steel during the period, an increase of 68.8 percent, the agency said.
The sharp increase had driven the price of domestic steel down, it said, without giving further details.
China produced about 94 million tonnes of rolled steel and imported 13.5 million tonnes in 1995.
